title: AlUla heritage and visitor map with a bilingual site list

headline.label: heritage sites listed from two open sources

service.name: Heritage and Tourism Mapping and Site Inventory

data: Wikidata (licence CC0) through its SPARQL service: every item with coordinates within 30 km of central AlUla and inside the map box, downloaded 2026-11-20.
method: Of 207 Wikidata items around AlUla we kept 22 with a heritage designation (P1435) or a heritage type: archaeological site, ancient city, tomb, museum, castle, petroglyph, rock formation, Hejaz Railway station.
From OpenStreetMap we took features tagged historic, heritage, or tourism as attraction, museum, viewpoint or gallery.
Sources are linked only by the wikidata tag written in OpenStreetMap, with no fuzzy name matching; any two sites 300 m or less apart are flagged for review.
Arabic and English names come from Wikidata labels, then OpenStreetMap name:ar, name:en and name when written in Arabic or Latin script; what is still missing stays blank.
limits: Not archaeological documentation or a field survey. Sites and their positions follow what contributors entered in Wikidata and OpenStreetMap, and some coordinates are one point for a large site. The list is not a complete inventory of AlUla, and some features contributors tagged as attractions are visitor facilities such as bus stops.
